products.title: Antonio Visconti Silver Wood Eau de Parfum, 100ml
products.description: Visconti perfumes has an unmistakable, specific and enduring olfactory signature, thanks to the concentration of the essences used. This lenght of time is essential if the perfume oils are to find the ideal condition to merge and form a final, perfect harmony that is sublime and sumptuous, able to make the most important moments of life even more special.

products.title: Frankie Garage Sporty Fragrance Blue Tag
products.description: The Sporty Fragrance collection by Frankie Garage has expanded to include Blue Tag, a dynamic men's fragrance with a woody-fougere character. Launched in 2021, this eau de toilette accentuates the wearer's sporty style. Blue Tag opens with cool citrus notes of bitter orange and green bergamot, a duo reinforced by the vanilla nuances of elemi resin and the warm spark of black pepper. At the heart, the spicy tone of geranium is enhanced by the resinous quality of juniper, the textured note of cinnamon, and the softness of clove. The fragrance leaves a charismatic trail featuring notes of leather, spicy patchouli leaves, and a woody blend of cedar and vetiver.
